question: A small firm currently works on individual Pro accounts and wants to standardise how client data is handled. What is the most relevant advantage of moving onto a business plan?
options: A) Members would no longer be able to upload any documents at all, which removes the risk of client data entering the tool.
B) Conversations become encrypted, which is not possible on any of the individually managed accounts.
C) The organisation gains owner-level control over connectors, retention and settings that individual accounts lack.
D) Individual accounts gain unlimited project storage, which removes any need to manage documents at all.
correct_answers: C) The organisation gains owner-level control over connectors, retention and settings that individual accounts lack.
explanations: Business plans do not remove the ability to upload documents.
This is not the distinction between personal and business plans.
Correct. Business plans put configuration and data controls in the hands of accountable owners rather than each person.
Storage is not the governance problem, and documents still need managing.
